{{Recipe summary
| Category = Meat recipes
| Difficulty = 3
}}

{{recipe}}

This dish of '''strip steaks''' is great on a steak or over pasta.

== Ingredients ==
* 2 [[Cookbook:Each|ea]]. (12–16 [[Cookbook:Ounce|ounces]]) 1 [[Cookbook:Inch|inch]]-thick New York [[Cookbook:Beef|strip steaks]]
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] cracked black [[Cookbook:Pepper|peppercorns]], divided
* 2 tbsp unsalted [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]
* 1 ½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|olive oil]] (not extra-virgin)
* ¼ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Beef|beef]] [[Cookbook:Broth|broth]]
* 1 cup [[Cookbook:Cream|heavy cream]]
* 2 tsp [[Cookbook:Worcestershire Sauce|Worcestershire sauce]]

== Procedure ==
#Season each steak with salt and a [[Cookbook:Pinch|pinch]] of cracked pepper on both sides. Set aside.
#Melt butter with olive oil in a stainless steel [[Cookbook:Frying Pan|skillet]] (don't use nonstick) over medium-high heat.
#Add steaks and cook 4–5 minutes per side for medium rare, 6–7 minutes for medium, and 8–9 minutes for toast.
#Remove steaks from pan and keep warm.
#Pour out pan drippings but do not scrape browned bits off. [[Cookbook:Deglazing|Deglaze]] pan with broth and bring to a [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]] over high heat until reduced by ⅔.
#Add remaining ingredients and remaining pepper. Bring to a boil and cook until reduced to ½ cup.
#Drizzle sauce over steaks and serve warm.
